content_sections.heading: IGNCA Project Manager Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IGNCA Project Manager Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for IGNCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the IGNCA Recruitment 2026 is Project Manager. This is a contractual position within the organization.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Manager post in the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to apply online; they can attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Postgraduate Degree in Business Management/ Marketing/ Retail management or Art History/ Museology/ History/ Fine Arts/ Conservation/ Anthropology or a related field from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Manager position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Manager role will receive a salary of Rs. 75,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview venue is in New Delhi, with a pincode of 110001. Specific address details should be confirmed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
